title: Evaluating User Experience in Conversational Recommender Systems: A Systematic Review Across Classical and LLM-Powered Approaches
reasoning: The paper is a systematic literature review focused on identifying and synthesizing user experience (UX) metrics, dimensions, and evaluation methods.
